# S12 — User-drawn cores (dry vs lime)

**Status:** not started  
**After:** S11 green  
**Cite:** REQUIREMENTS §8.4, §8.6.1, DEC-033, DEC-034, DEC-044–047, DEC-050  
**Forbidden:** Auto-generated cores or skins; coloring a dry-core wall with full-thickness kern; coupling core binder to facing joints

## Done when

- [ ] `npx vitest run tests/slices/s12.test.ts` passes
- [ ] Solid wall until the user draws a `rubble` core; skins are the remainder, **wythe-snapped**
- [ ] New core binder default **dry**; lime-bound is opt-in
- [ ] Dry: kern = **cut-stone skins + ring only**. Lime-bound: kern may use **full wall** (compression mass, no tension)
- [ ] Through-stones project into/through the core at bonding courses
- [ ] Switching only binder re-runs analysis; inspector A/B: H, max e, crushing, spread, lime volume, cost proxy (1:3 mix)

## Given

S01-scale thick wall; user-drawn core pocket.

## When

Draw core; snap skins; toggle dry | lime-bound.

## Then

Dry kern width ≠ full wall thickness. No auto inset generator.

## Test command

`npx vitest run tests/slices/s12.test.ts`

## Stop

STATUS.md.
